title: LILRB4 expression is associated with macrophage enrichment and differential survival in hepatocellular carcinoma.
snippet: The clinical and immune-cell context of leukocyte immunoglobulin-like receptor B4 (LILRB4) in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains incompletely characterized. This study aimed to characterize LILRB4 expression across cell types and examine its associations with survival outcomes and macrophage-related immune features in HCC. title: Sequential blood-brain barrier-penetrating and microglial-mitochondria-targeting nanosystem for ischemic stroke therapy.
